beats.summary: Michael organizes a charity auction called Crime-Aid to help recoup losses from office robberies.

evidence.snippet: Michael: To recoup their losses, I am planning a little charity auction, where people from all over Scranton can come and bid on our goods and services. I'm calling it crime-aid.
Michael: Pump it up! Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! Pump up the volume. Thank you very much, everybody. Thank you, Mr. Springsteen. And welcome to C.R.I.M.E.-A.I.D.

beats.summary: Dwight pressures Angela to break off her engagement and date him instead.

evidence.snippet: Angela: I think you have me confused with another person.

beats.summary: The auction features various items including yoga lessons from Holly and a weekend at David Wallace's place.

beats.summary: Michael bids on an item at the auction, but Darryl points out it is a conflict of interest.

evidence.snippet: Darryl: Mike, you can't do that. It's conflict of interest.

beats.summary: The auction includes humorous moments such as a squeaky gavel and Kevin's failed tax service bid.
